verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha … and said to him:
“Sir, they speak of this thing called ‘the world’.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, lokoti vuccatī”ti?

verses.english: “It wears away, mendicant, that’s why it’s called ‘the world’.

verses.pali: Rūpā lujjanti, cakkhuviññāṇaṁ lujjati, cakkhusamphasso lujjati, yampidaṁ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi lujjati …pe…
verses.english: Sights … eye consciousness … eye contact is wearing away. The painful, pleasant, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on eye contact is also wearing away.

verses.pali: mano lujjati, dhammā lujjanti, manoviññāṇaṁ lujjati, manosamphasso lujjati, yampidaṁ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi lujjati.
verses.english: The mind … ideas … mind consciousness … mind contact is wearing away. The painful, pleasant, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact is also wearing away.

verses.pali: Lujjatīti kho, bhikkhu, tasmā lokoti vuccatī”ti.
verses.english: It wears away, mendicant, that’s why it’s called ‘the world’.”
